entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I hope you can help. I ordered a jersey and it arrived, but... I think I need to send it back. The website is just so confusing, I don't know what to do.
I can certainly help you with a return. Do you have your order number handy?
Oh, um, yes, I think so. It's... VF-987654.

Great, thank you. I'm pulling that up now. I see the ProFit Jersey, delivered on January 20th. So I can best assist you, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

A preference, I guess? I think I ordered the wrong size. It's just... really too tight in the shoulders. I thought I followed the size chart, but I must have read it wrong. Can't you just help me? I don't know what the policy is.
Of course, that's what I'm here for. It sounds like you'd be interested in an exchange for a larger size, is that right?
An exchange? Yes! That would be perfect. I was worried I'd just have to be stuck with it.

Not at all. Your jersey falls under our 10-day policy, and since you're unfortunately outside that window, an exchange is no problem at all. I can process that for you right now and email you a pre-paid return label.
Oh, that's such a relief. So you'll just send me a label and I can mail the old one back?
Exactly. Once the post office scans your return package, we'll immediately ship the new size out to you. Which size would you like for the exchange?
A Medium, please. Thank you so much, Sarah. You've made this so easy.
You are very welcome. I've put the exchange through for a size Medium. The email with your return label should arrive in the next five minutes. Is there anything else I can help with?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
